messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty ALERT — P10023 fired for customer AcmeCorp (private control plane). Symptom: on-prem agent heartbeat lost >5m. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incident/P10023

Alex G: Acked in PD. grabbing runbook now.

Suresh (oncall): I'm on it. Confirm which region for AcmeCorp?

Maria L: AcmeCorp eu-west-1. CS already pinged their infra team. They see 502s and timeouts since ~10:24 UTC.

Alex G: Runbook step 1: SSH to agent and check service. quick command:
```
ssh redwood@acme-agent-1 'sudo systemctl status redwood-agent'
```

Suresh (oncall): ran it, service is inactive (dead). pulling logs now.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation to senior-oncall in 9m if not acknowledged.

Alex G: attempting graceful restart:
```
ssh redwood@acme-agent-1 'sudo systemctl restart redwood-agent && journalctl -u redwood-agent -n 200'
```

Suresh (oncall): restart -> service comes up then dies after ~30s. tail of journal shows repeated TLS handshake errors. snippet:
```
2026-03-14T10:26:12Z ERROR tls: handshake failed: certificate expired on peer
2026-03-14T10:26:13Z WARN reconnect: backoff 3s
```

Maria L: CS note: they said they rotated certs last month, but maybe auto-rotation didn't complete. They're worried about production traffic.

Alex G: looks like agent certificate expired and auto-rotation failed. quick mitigation per runbook: enable agent TLS bypass (temporary) so control plane can re-establish and we can rotate certs from the control plane. Doing that now.

Suresh (oncall): applying bypass flag via control plane API: `curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/customers/acme/agents/acme-agent-1/bypass -d '{"ttl":600}'` -> 200. Agent attempting reconnect.

Suresh (oncall): heartbeats back. control plane reports agent connected. metrics: heartbeats -> green, requests flowing.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: P10023 acknowledged by Alex G. :white_check_mark:

Tanya (CS): I told Acme support it's a certificate rotation issue, and we applied a temporary bypass. They confirmed traffic looks normal on their side. Sending status update to their team.

Alex G: Next steps: schedule a proper cert rotation + fix auto-rotation. I'll open ticket to schedule rotation window with Acme and run the rotation test. also will add post-incident notes and RCA starter.

Jamal (oncall): taking handoff for follow-up. ETA 60m to run rotation test and validate auto-rotate. If anything regresses -> page me.

Suresh (oncall): adding runbook link and logs to the incident: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/agent-cert-rotation and attaching journal excerpt.

Alex G: will keep PD incident open for 30m monitoring then close if stable. leaving chat open for any rapid updates. :eyes:

incident-bot: Note: PagerDuty P10023 closed by Alex G at 10:58 UTC (monitoring period completed). :white_check_mark:
